# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This project is about building a Docker web application, that is deployed to an existing AWS instance.

## Instructions for GitHub Copilot

1. When writing code, always follow the project's coding standards.
2. Ensure that Docker configurations are correctly set up for deployment.
3. Include necessary AWS deployment scripts and configurations.
4. Write clear and concise commit messages.
5. Document any changes made to the deployment process.
6. Variables and secrets must be placed securely into GitHub secrets and environments.
7. No secrets or sensitive information should be hardcoded in the codebase.
8. Always review and test deployment scripts before applying them to the production environment.
9. Keep the documentation up to date with any changes in the deployment process.
10. Regularly review and update GitHub Copilot instructions to reflect any changes in project practices.
